chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Recommending Mike Bryan to Goodman and receiving Christian's guitar
summary: Collins recommended Bryan for Goodman, who got Christian's Gibson and amp, then gave them to Collins, causing nightly arguments with Roy.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: And Mike made the audition and got the job. In the meantime Charlie Christian was the featured guitarist, and consequently Mike and Charlie became very good friends, and Charlie Christian gave Mike an electric guitar, and an amplifier, that Gibson had given him. But they were giving Charlie quite a few guitars at that time so he gave him a new guitar and amplifier and Charlie gave it to Mike. And Mike out of appreciation for my getting him the job gave me the electric -- Charlie's electric guitar and amplifier. This was the first electric guitar I ever had.

And I would try to play it on the stand with Roy, and Roy didn't like the sound of the electric guitar, and we would fight every night because Roy wanted me to play acoustic guitar. But the mere fact that it was Charlie's guitar I was going to fight Roy. But that's really how I started playing electric guitar. And my first electric guitar was Charlie Christian's guitar. So I thought there would be of interest.
Incidently, Mike Bryan worked with Benny for quite a

while, and he just died not too long ago here in Los Angeles. But he also was producing a show in Europe for the Ford Foundation. Some kind of jazz show over there. And he would bring all the big musicians from here, from America over there to do these shows. Mike was quite a guy.

But any way he died about a year ago, and Georgia All came by to tell me because we were all very dear friends. Now, I had to just inject that because I didn't -- I thought it would be of some interest to you. [PAUSE]
